Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any worn item or minion whose mod uses Hikari's fur textures, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it. The mods aren't included.
Punchline: Real strand fur on items that use Hikari's fur textures.
Changelog: About twice as fast: fur hidden behind other fur is no longer drawn, with the same look (on a full fur coat at 3 m the fur's GPU time dropped from about 11 ms to 5.5 ms per frame). Tidier settings window with Performance, GPose, Strand shape, Colour and light and a collapsed Advanced section; every tooltip now explains in plain words what higher and lower values do. Temporal smoothing now defaults to 90% (settings you already saved keep their value).
